items.title: 63520_Ernie Fields oral history interview
items.q: this young man that came from my band, Minerve

ctx.x: black thing we had. And to pretend that there isn't a difference, there is a difference. Afro-American art is Afro-American art to a large extent, and the thing that Basie and Duke and Lundsford and all those had, and your band, was so unique; what's going to happen when Basie goes? This thing that Mercer, that Ellington is going around with, I don't consider.
No, and I don't know why, that even though he has a band, like I said this young man that came from my band, Minerve, the band is good, but it's some kind of way--
